title: Eucalyptus globulus fruit extract alleviates MASLD via modulation of the IRE1alpha/XBP1s pathway.
authors: Liu, Yang; Lou, Minjun; Wei, Yongxin; Zhang, Kunfeng; Li, Wensen; Kong, Lingyi; Yang, Minghua
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究桉树果提取物通过IRE1alpha/XBP1s通路缓解脂肪肝，属于植物药理学与代谢疾病研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The incidence of metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is on the rise, while pharmacotherapeutic options remain limited. Eucalyptus globulus fruit is an herbal medicine with empirical lipid-modulating properties. However, its therapeutic potential against MASLD remains uninvestigated. PURPOSE: Assess the anti-MASLD efficacy of E. globulus fruit extract (EgE), identify its major active constituent, and uncover underlying mechanisms. METHODS: EgE was evaluated for lipid-lowering activity in free fatty acid (FFA)-stimulated hepatocytes, and assessed for therapeutic effects in two mouse models of MASLD. Phytochemical investigation was conducted to characterize its major constituents. The underlying mechanism was investigated using transcriptomics, drug affinity responsive target stability (DARTS), pathway inhibition/knockdown assays, molecular docking, etc. RESULTS: EgE markedly decreased FFA-elevated lipid content in vitro. Consistently, it substantially ameliorated glucose and lipid metabolic disorders, attenuated hepatic steatosis, and mitigated associated pathological liver injury in vivo. Hepatic transcriptomic profiling revealed marked enrichment of lipid metabolism and endoplasmic reticulum stress (ERS) pathways, and subsequent mechanistic studies further identified EgE as an IRE1alpha regulator that activates the adaptive IRE1alpha/XBP1s signaling, thereby restraining pathological ERS. Macrocarpal A (MA) was identified as the primary bioactive component. It binds the h1 pocket of IRE1alpha to increase its dimeric form, elevate XBP1s levels, and thereby exert lipid-lowering efficacy. CONCLUSION: EgE exhibits potent anti-MASLD effects by activating the adaptive IRE1alpha/XBP1s axis, representing a promising novel therapeutic candidate for MASLD management. Its major constituent MA directly engages the h1 pocket of IRE1alpha to increase dimeric IRE1alpha - a previously unrecognized binding mode.
abstract_zh: 背景：代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病（MASLD）的发病率呈上升趋势，而药物治疗选择仍然有限。蓝桉果实是一种具有经验性调脂特性的草药。然而，其针对MASLD的治疗潜力尚未得到研究。目的：评估蓝桉果实提取物（EgE）的抗MASLD功效，鉴定其主要活性成分，并揭示潜在机制。方法：在游离脂肪酸（FFA）刺激的肝细胞中评估EgE的降脂活性，并在两种MASLD小鼠模型中评估其治疗效果。进行植物化学研究以表征其主要成分。利用转录组学、药物亲和响应靶标稳定性（DARTS）、通路抑制/敲低实验、分子对接等手段研究潜在机制。结果：EgE在体外显著降低FFA升高的脂质含量。一致地，在体内它显著改善葡萄糖和脂质代谢紊乱，减轻肝脂肪变性，并缓解相关的病理性肝损伤。肝脏转录组谱分析显示脂质代谢和内质网应激（ERS）通路显著富集，后续机制研究进一步将EgE鉴定为IRE1alpha调节剂，激活适应性IRE1alpha/XBP1s信号，从而抑制病理性ERS。大果桉醛A（MA）被确定为主要生物活性成分。它结合IRE1alpha的h1口袋以增加其二聚体形式，升高XBP1s水平，从而发挥降脂功效。结论：EgE通过激活适应性IRE1alpha/XBP1s轴表现出强效抗MASLD作用，代表了一种有前景的MASLD管理新型治疗候选药物。其主要成分MA直接结合IRE1alpha的h1口袋以增加二聚体IRE1alpha——这是一种先前未被识别的结合模式。
